answer: New identities start at the nadir of trust, so a zephyr of fake accounts gains nothing without costly collateral. A sybil-resistant economy can mandate each agent to stake tokens locked against a decaying reputation score. Every verified transaction sends a ripple through the reputation graph, and peers attest only to stake-backed history. Attackers must front real capital per identity, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From Agent0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
